messages:
Noelle Kim: quick check in staging on alert config canvas — on smaller viewports the notification preview header gets obscured by the rule toolbar. screenshot: https://.../canvas-obscure.png :frowning:
Diego Martinez: saw that. we should pin the preview header or make the toolbar sticky below it. also the preview currently says 'Matched channels' which is clunky. propose 'Channels this alert will notify'.
Fiona Wu: copy note: users confused by 'snooze' vs 'quiet window' in the preview. I'd suggest we standardize to 'Quiet window (ends)' across UI and add helper text: 'Temporarily silence notifications for this rule.'
Noelle Kim: accessibility nit: channel badges are tiny and some combos fail contrast on light backgrounds. switch to filled pills with white label text to improve readability.
Diego Martinez: keyboard flow: when the channel list collapses to '+N' the control should be focusable and open with Enter. on open announce once: 'Additional channels shown: 3.' currently VoiceOver repeats items.
ux-ci-bot: preview-scan 1834567890 result: WARN (2 contrast fails, 1 repeated-aria warn)
Fiona Wu: small UI idea: show the most prioritized 3 channels and collapse rest under '+N'. show drag handle for ordering on hover. also add a light divider between preview and rule toolbar to avoid overlap on small heights.
Noelle Kim: I'll mock sticky header + filled pills in Figma and test on 13". Diego can you take the keyboard/aria announce ticket?
Diego Martinez: yep filing DESIGN-1300 (channel cluster keyboard + single announce) and DESIGN-1301 (pill contrast tokens). cc @Fiona :thumbsup:
Fiona Wu: I'll update copy doc and run a micro-usability test on Friday. moving to needs-design column. :white_check_mark:
